content_metadata.description: Video announcement of Nick and Terese about their new catamaran project, Ruby Rose 2, their excitement about building a custom catamaran, and their commitment to transparency with their audience.

qAndA.answer: A montage of 16 catamarans is shown between 1:03 - 1:10, including: St. Francis 50, Discovery 50, Majestic 530, Outremer 51, Seawind 1260, Knysna 500SE, Xquisite X5, Antares 440S, Balance 526, Maverick 440, Catana 53, Seawind 1600, Nautitech 46, Privilege Series 5, Lagoon 42, Leopard 40.
qAndA.question: What specific catamaran brands did the couple review?

qAndA.answer: Terese explicitly mentions that they are not the only ones involved in the project (2:49) and everyone needs to be aligned before disclosing further information.
qAndA.question: Why were the couple hesitant to share all the details about Ruby Rose 2?

qAndA.answer: Nick emphasizes the importance of incorporating 'lots of design features that we find really important' (2:02). Terese adds that they want the boat to be 'perfectly set up the way that we want it to be' (3:09), tailored to their cruising needs and preferences.
qAndA.question: What is the couple's primary goal in building a custom catamaran?

qAndA.answer: Terese reveals that the catamaran will be 'completely green' (3:15) and run solely on solar power and a large bank of lithium batteries.
qAndA.question: How will Ruby Rose 2 be powered?

qAndA.answer: Nick assures viewers they will be showing 'plans, schematics, walkthroughs, and really show you everything' (4:40-4:41) once they are able to. This suggests in-depth coverage of the design, construction, and outfitting of Ruby Rose 2.
qAndA.question: What specific details will be shared with viewers in the future?

youtube_description:
Keeping Secrets is hard! Keeping the biggest secret of our Sailing Careers to ourselves is impossible. The question: What catamaran is Ruby Rose 2 going to be?
We have so many questions and emails asking what we have chosen and when we are going to reveal our choice.

Well today we are halfway there. Before we pop with excitement we are super, super excited to let you in on what we are doing for our next boat. It's epic, exciting and the most ambitious project we have EVER embarked upon!

The next 12 months are going to be a whirlwind of information as we prepare to launch the first ever production boat designed by a naval architect with incorporated design features from a couple who sail and also own a YouTube Channel.

If you are interested in following along with this project, please make sure you are subscribed, and also head over to our website at http://www.yachtrubyrose.com to sign up for our newsletter.


Enjoy!
Cheers, 
Nick & Terysa
